lines.text: Yesterday this path brought me here three times. Today it brought me here before I left.

lines.text: My brother left a mark on that gate. I check it every morning.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: To see whether it has been replaced?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: To remember that he got through once.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Is he safe?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: He sends complaints about the food. I keep all of them.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That sounds like useful mail.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: These instruments will repair time.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Our foundations are washing away while you say that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The maintenance ledger shows Galactic holding fractures open while Lysandre’s network extracts material through them.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: They made the repairs sound like a debt.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The residents already paid. In labor, mostly.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Could we help them keep a record?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: They have records. They need somebody to honor them.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then we will carry the records out of the office.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Take the muddy ones first. Those are the people still working.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: These components do not belong to one yesterday.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: He said the system recovered what we lost.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You secure a distribution key that can isolate civilian pumps. Nobody has established what extraction does to the source.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You keep saying we. Who is left from your crew?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Most of them. We stopped speaking for a while. That made the work worse and the lunches unbearable.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What did you say when you went back?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I said I was sorry. Then I asked who needed a spanner.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did that fix it?
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: The pipe? Yes. The rest is taking longer.
lines.direction: tired warmth; make room for the joke

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Somebody packed a whole room into those crates.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I saw a name beneath the inventory number.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We should leave it visible.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I will need a ladder and a different color of paint.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can read them out to you.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Slowly. We are not losing another name in a hurry.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: My machines ensure there will still be something to save.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You take from somewhere you will not even name.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: Would you prefer I abandon this place?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Stop pretending those are the only choices.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Lysandre
lines.text: Ada. You once understood what this place could become.
lines.direction: smooth persuasion; Ada refuses to be rushed

lines.text: I remember what you promised it would cost.

lines.text: The clinic is still worth saving. So are the people you made it depend on hurting.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: She brought the plans to keep the civilian pumps running.

lines.direction: smooth persuasion; Ada refuses to be rushed

lines.text: Lysandre looks past her, toward the recovery console.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You win. Lysandre orders a network recovery, but Ada uses the access you recovered to interrupt it. Broken barricades stay broken.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something enormous moves beneath the hall.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I wanted his promise to be possible.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: So did half the people building these walls.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He did not tell them what it would cost to keep it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: They asked. Eventually they stopped being invited to ask.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We can keep asking together.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And make sure other people can hear the answers.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Seismitoad ruling the realm blocks the extraction engine. Its calls coordinate the patrols.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Keep it away from the controls. I can disconnect the network.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What happens when it stops?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Tomorrow, we fix things ourselves.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The engine falls silent. Patrol calls stop. Lysandre escapes, but loses this supply network.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Now people can choose what they rebuild.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The water sounds different with the gate open.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I kept waiting for it to return to where it was.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I might keep doing that for a while.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can wait until the first boat passes.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: That boat has been waiting longer than we have.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then let us get out of its way.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: People need these pump parts.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: Civilian maintenance is suspended. Authorized infrastructure will be restored.

lines.text: After victory you carry supplies through the gate. Behind you, the checkpoint begins restoring itself.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Keep moving. Winning bought us time.

lines.text: You have been working since we arrived.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact kindness

lines.text: Ada looks at the two of you, then lowers herself onto a supply crate.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Five minutes. If anyone calls it an intervention, I am getting up.

lines.text: A sealed audit names an Expedition–Skyridge realm. Galactic marked it: Continuity purge completed. Surviving material approved for reclamation.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: They told us these were abandoned remnants.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We do not know that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then we go and look.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Residents dismantle a barricade. This time others help carry the pieces away.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Take the insulated gloves. Those old machines never respect a dramatic farewell.

lines.speaker: Ada

lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: What will you do while we are gone?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Finish clearing this street. I would like to see its other end.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And if the wall returns?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Then I will have help carrying it. That part has changed.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I hope the street is very long.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A stone road ends halfway across a bridge. Beyond lies neither fog nor darkness: there is nowhere for a falling leaf to go.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Galactic’s abandoned map crosses out most of a region. Another hand wrote: People still live here.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Some places were severed in the purge. Other structures disappeared afterward. Those were what Lysandre took.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Edda keeps a register of missing people and Pokémon. She asks you to look for survivors, not assume their absence means annihilation.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Edda leaves her register open while she sets out another bowl.
lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were you expecting us?
lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: No. Someone was going to be hungry eventually.

lines.speaker: Celebi

lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: May we sit?
lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Please. The register will still be here after supper.
lines.direction: reserved hospitality; the hurt is ordinary

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Do not lean over the broken edge. I cannot promise there is a bottom.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Can you promise there is a way back?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: To my house, yes. I marked the turn with a blue cloth.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is a useful promise.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I have become careful about the size of them.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Was this your home before the purge?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: This part was. There used to be considerably more of it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Will you show us what is still here?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: Can your Pokémon hold their ground when the way back disappears? We prepare here before taking the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: After the trial Oren marks a safe route. Celebi offers to restore the missing bridge.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Do you know what is on the other side? Then we find out first.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: I used to count every step across that bridge. Made the dark feel shorter.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: It changed. I hated that.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do you count now?

lines.text: Does that make the dark shorter?
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Every morning?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Oren

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Do you get used to it?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: Can your Pokémon hold their ground when the way back disappears? We prepare here before taking the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: After the trial Oren marks a safe route. Celebi offers to restore the missing bridge.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Do you know what is on the other side? Then we find out first.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: I used to count every step across that bridge. Made the dark feel shorter.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: How many?
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: It changed. I hated that.
lines.direction: easy manner; a remembered fear

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do you count now?

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: People across. Then I take my lantern back for the next one.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Does that make the dark shorter?

lines.speaker: Oren

lines.text: I test that plank before breakfast.

lines.speaker: You

lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Were they frightened of what was inside?

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Perhaps. The instruction only says it was no longer viable.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That is an easy phrase to use from a distant desk.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: We should bring the desk here.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You read my reports.

lines.speaker: Engineer
lines.text: I could not make the routes agree.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: So you stopped counting the people on them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: Galactic severed contradictory branches to simplify the origin-site calculation. The purge failed and destabilized adjacent routes.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: My old kitchen is still on their map. My neighbor’s house is marked as an empty parcel.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was it damaged?
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: She painted the door blue the week before the order. She wanted the children to find it easily.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What was her name?
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Maren. I will show you how she writes it. She has a very untidy M.
lines.direction: anger held in careful words

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: There are little repairs all over the walls.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: I know those knots. Somebody taught a child to make them.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The report missed all of that.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: It counted the failed supports. It never counted the people holding them up.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: Carry the names. Find out what became of them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: The passage points to 2006. Familiar Pokémon signatures carry unfamiliar elemental readings.

lines.text: Missing from a map does not mean gone.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: There is a letter inside the back cover. You need not read it.

lines.text: Lightning strikes a lake. A Delta Gyarados rises and nudges your stranded boat toward shore. An evacuation ribbon hangs from a nearby post.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Were you expecting something else?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: In Newbank, Maren recognizes Edda’s copied register. Years have passed here while much less time passed in the refuge.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: She kept the names? Tell her we arrived.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Dr. Sen
lines.text: In this fractured branch, the crossing changed the Pokémon’s elemental signatures. The tower helped us stabilize their new habitat. Galactic wants to force an older baseline.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Put that register somewhere dry. I am going to fuss over it and I would rather admit that now.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: I have written so many answers in my head. Now I cannot remember how to begin.

lines.text: It has opinions about people who ignore the weather.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Are they good opinions?

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Usually. It was right about us yesterday.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is the bell part of the warning system?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Sometimes. Today it tells the kitchen we have visitors.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I think I understand that kind of bell.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: You keep looking at Raichu like it is doing something wrong.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I am learning.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Good. It is patient with that.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Ivo

lines.text: Do you remember the old place?

lines.speaker: Ivo

lines.direction: pride without a lecture

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did the tree survive?

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: You are sitting under it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What do they ask now?

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Where to get dry clothes. I prefer that.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I was going to ask whether you were frightened.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.text: Sometimes. That question is all right, too.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: Then we can start with clothes and keep talking.

lines.text: We will prepare together before entering the unstable inlet.

lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Would that be an alarm?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Here, yes. Across the channel it might sound like home.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: How do we know what they will hear?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Tell them who is ringing before we begin.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can introduce the bell, too.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: First restore the region. Resettlement follows.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: That is what you told us before the purge.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You have not prepared homes for them.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: Galactic withdraws but leaves its forced correction cycle running. The lake guardian becomes distressed.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They called changing them a correction.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What would the people here call it?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: We could ask. I would like them to hear someone ask.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: May we stay for the answer?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Yes. Put the instruments down for a while.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We have been looking through too many of those lately.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It remembers losing a home.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then we protect this one.

lines.text: Yes. I am trying to remember that earlier next time.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can ask before the next climb.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It could leave.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: It knows. It stays because this is where others arrive.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian reveals energy straining to keep a damaged connection open. It cannot tell whether releasing it would help.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: The sanctuary keeps its own pace.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You sounded different while we were waiting.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: I was trying to make waiting look like my idea.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Would you rather we had asked?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Yes. I would have had to admit I needed the rest.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will ask now. Do you?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: Celebi can finish the crossing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We are listening to those who know what is beyond it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After defeat the captain accepts evacuation and releases the recorder. It shows volcanic light and a vast silhouette: GROUDON EVENT — ANCHOR FRAGMENT DETECTED.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: You would spend your supplies bringing my team down?
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: You are on the mountain. We have ropes.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: After what we tried to do?
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: You will answer questions below. Hold the rope properly or neither of us will enjoy the journey.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You can be angry and still help.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I have considerable practice.
lines.direction: level and resolute

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: They left the smallest packs behind first.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Did they think the small things mattered less?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: They may have thought they would be back by evening.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We should not decide for them what can be discarded.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can carry a little more.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Then choose something whose owner we can find.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I cannot promise to fix everything. I will not pretend I understand something because I fear it.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Coming back is part of the task.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The guardian grants controlled passage. Celebi remembers Dialga before his transformation, waiting patiently beside a damaged structure.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I trusted him.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It waited until we were all on the same side.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: A bridge keeper should count travelers.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: You began doing that without noticing.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Bram taught us. He might be pleased.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: He will probably tell us what else we missed.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: That sounds like someone worth returning to.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The route leads backward to 2004 and a molten realm. Sera gives you a signal charm linked to a retreat point.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Was Dialga the one you heard?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Yes. I want to find out what happened before deciding what he deserves.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Before the passage opens, you share the last watch beside the stove.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What do you miss?
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: An ordinary walk. Getting tired because we went a little too far, not because the path disappeared.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I have been asking you to keep going.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I have been choosing to. I am allowed to be tired, too.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When we get home, can we take a walk?
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: A very ordinary one.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We might need to practice.
lines.direction: companions speaking when nobody needs an answer

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought being strong would mean being less frightened.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Tarin
lines.text: Sometimes it means having enough breath to say you are frightened.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: Preferably before you step onto the bridge.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We did make it across.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Because you waited when I stopped.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Tarin
lines.text: We were traveling together.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Lio
lines.text: And because nobody was allowed to eat the return provisions.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We should keep that rule.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A petrified tree protrudes from black stone. Rivers glow beneath their crust. Groudon moves in the basin below.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I surveyed this land for Magma. Now I maintain evacuation routes.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Magma amplified an exposed anchor fragment to raise new land. Groudon is caught in a feedback cycle. Galactic investigated and withdrew; Maxie pursues his own ambition.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That red line is mine. I drew it through a garden. The owner asked me to move it six feet.
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you?
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I told her it was only a survey. Nothing had been decided.
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What happened to the garden?
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I am still trying to find out. Do not tell me I could not have known. I could have listened.
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Show us which road gets the water through.
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rhea uncaps her pencil and moves the map between you.
lines.direction: plain and guarded; no heroic self-description

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Do not brush the ash off that rail. Check whether it is hot first.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: How do you tell?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Carefully. I learned the other method once.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Is your hand all right?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: It healed. The lesson has been less convenient.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You can tell us those lessons before we need them.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I will. There are rather a lot.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We have a journal with room left.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: People built this station before your expansion.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.text: Civilian collection resumes when construction is complete.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You restore water deliveries. A resident points toward a flash preceding each tremor.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then we follow the light.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: We used to ration water by who had the longest job.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Who decided that?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I did, sometimes. We stopped when people hid their injuries.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What do you do now?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Ask who needs help reaching the next station.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can carry another bottle.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: We prepare here before taking the repair crew in.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cooling station was deliberately redirected toward an amplifier. Magma is actively sustaining the spread.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: Those goggles are not a decoration. Put them over your eyes.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought they were yours.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I am wearing mine. I look like this underneath them as well.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You sound very calm.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I am following the checklist. The calm is a favorable side effect.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Do you always carry a spare pair?
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: Someone always thinks they are a decoration.
lines.direction: gruff fondness; an unhurried laugh

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I thought the tree was a chimney when I first saw it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What did you think when you got closer?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: That I had never bothered to learn its name.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You have been looking after it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: I can do that before I know.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That is how Rowan began with me.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: You cannot break what you do not understand.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Then give us the instructions.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Restricted.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You secure the intact cooling controls and a safe sequence for reducing output without collapse.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The channel still carries supplies past the broken supports.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: There are people at both ends who refuse to stop checking it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Can we tell them it held?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Yes. Give them the time and who was watching.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: More than just the measurements?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: A crew can use the name of someone to thank.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: You arrived before the work was complete.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: We brought your own surveys. The foundations are not secure.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: You were one of my best surveyors, Rhea.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I know. That is why I thought you would read the report.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: I read it.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rhea’s hand tightens around the rolled map.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Then do not make me explain the numbers again. Tell me why they were acceptable to you.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Maxie
lines.text: There was more at stake than one settlement.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It is never your settlement in that sentence.
lines.direction: restrained confrontation; do not shout

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After victory the crew begins a controlled shutdown. Maxie reaches for emergency controls, then sees Groudon struggling against another pulse. He leaves them untouched.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I used to rehearse speeches like that on the walk to work.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: What changed?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The walk. It became an evacuation route.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Would you tell him that?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I just did. I wanted you to hear me do it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We heard. So did the crews outside.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: We can stop the machinery.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will hold here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: When the pulses stop, I can reach the fragment.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The last amplifier falls silent. Groudon settles onto the stone. Lava remains, but the next expected tremor never comes.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Together the crew transfers the remaining load. Only then does Celebi recover the fragment and close its small fracture.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Dalen
lines.text: You can stop counting the intervals now. The gauge has settled.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Give it another minute.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dalen sets a cup of clean water beside her without taking the gauge away.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You do not have to pretend you are relieved yet.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Good. I do not think I remember how.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can wait.
lines.direction: exhaustion; let the relief arrive late

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: The fragment is warm.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Give it a resting place before you try to carry it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We have been making that mistake with more than fragments.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I thought putting it down might mean losing it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I will watch it while you get a cloth.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And I will watch the route.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can carry another bottle.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: The new map accounts for potential.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: The old one accounted for people.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Original surveys show cavities beneath supposedly stable expansion zones.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: My first map left out the places I could not measure.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: This one marks them as inhabited.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Someone sent the correction back with a cooking pot drawn on it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: A useful map symbol.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I have started using it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Mira would probably ask for a legend.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Commander
lines.text: You believed in this.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I believed you would stop if it hurt people.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Maxie overrode warnings. You recover a procedure to isolate the fragment without tearing the installation apart.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I kept the badge for a week after I left. Put it in a drawer each morning. Took it out again.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you think Maxie would change his mind?
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I wanted him to say I had been right. An embarrassing thing to want while people needed a road.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Do you still want it?
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Some days. I can want it and get the water delivered anyway.
lines.direction: strained; permit the player to disagree

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: The order makes the settlement look very far away.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It took us half a day to reach it.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: I will put the walking time beside the distance.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: And the places where somebody offered water.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That would improve several of my maps.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can start with this one.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: It was true. I wanted to turn around and check.

lines.text: We did not promise to finish their lives for them.

lines.text: I would like to ask how they are doing when we get home.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.text: There will be time to listen to the answer.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I remember believing that.

lines.text: What do you believe now?

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You are coming with me.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: You asked Celebi to name the present. What would you name?
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Your lantern. Vale breathing into the receiver. My hands shaking.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Mine are, too.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You could have said.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Yes. I am learning to take the chair I keep offering everyone else.
lines.direction: sincere; the caretaker accepts care

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I wanted to tell the echo to stop before I heard it finish.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Would it have understood why?
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I might not have. I thought somebody needed me to stay.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I need you to tell me when you cannot keep holding.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I can tell you now.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: We are listening.
lines.direction: Conversational; leave room for the answer.
